skill_addons.note_building:
How to explain in a note:
- Open each section with a why or how question, or a puzzling fact from the excerpt, then a case the student already knows.
- Answer it plainly within the next three lines, before any detail.
- Build in steps of two or three lines, each saying why it follows from the last; put a diagram, plot or figure between steps where it shows the mechanism.
- After each key fact, one sentence linking it to something the student already knows.
- Name the common misconception and why it is tempting.
- Return to the opening question at the end of the section, then one what-if question that changes one condition, in a ```quiz or ```flashcards fence (its answer stays hidden until tried).
